{"summary":"Users report audio sync issues across iPhone 7 and X on both Verizon and AT&T, persisting since iOS 10. [#tk_2652619]
Bluetooth toggles on the control center fail to fully disable the feature, causing unwanted connections. [#tk_2449488]
Wi‑Fi remains active after being turned off, and personal hotspot options appear even when disabled. [#tk_2185386]
The device often disconnects from car Bluetooth when not streaming audio, leading to safety concerns. [#tk_177809]
Users also note that airplane mode restores Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, and cellular by default, which is inconvenient. [#tk_2449499]"}
